system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The observed failures target svc-claimsync and originate from FILE-HD-01; the FILE-HD-01 events identify WorkstationName=FILE-HD-01 and source address 10.30.20.20.
The FILE-HD-01 failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the inventory description that ClaimSync runs and re-authenticates every minute.
The failures report an incorrect-password status (SubStatus=0xc000006a), and domain-controller validation events also show status 0xc000006a.

The observed failures begin after the scheduled 13:30 UTC svc-claimsync password rotation. Their recurring timing and FILE-HD-01 origin are consistent with the job continuing to use an outdated credential before its manual update; the logs do not independently confirm that the rotation occurred.
The supplied records contain Kerberos pre-authentication failures for svc-claimsync from the same FILE-HD-01 address during the interval.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records cover 13:35:56 through 13:50:53 UTC, not the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The records show failed authentication attempts but do not establish whether svc-claimsync had successful logons elsewhere or later in the requested window.
No job execution, service configuration, password-change, or credential-update records were supplied to verify that the scheduled rotation occurred or when ClaimSync was updated.
The process shown in the failure events is lsass.exe; these records do not identify the application or job that initiated each authentication attempt.
claims_not_established: That the scheduled password rotation was completed at 13:30 UTC.
That the ClaimSync job was updated with the new password, or when it was updated.
That there were no additional authentication attempts or successful logons between 13:50 and 14:20 UTC.
That the failures were caused by ClaimSync rather than another process using the same account from FILE-HD-01.
additional_evidence_needed: For confirmation of the operational explanation, review FILE-HD-01 ClaimSync job/service logs and credential-update records around 13:30–14:20 UTC.
If the alert scope requires validation of the entire hour, obtain DC-HD-01 and FILE-HD-01 authentication records for the missing portions of 13:20–14:20 UTC.
